title: Mirror Law: Reference Quality and the Transfer of Systematic Bias in Imitation and Distillation (code + paper)
description: Reproduction code and manuscript for the preprint 'The Mirror Law' (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21282027). Includes seeded CPU experiments E1-E6, the real-LLM E7 DPO study, the Mirror Audit tools (deceptive-descent detector, gold-centered rho estimator, effective-context probe), and the headline figure. Code under Apache-2.0; paper and figures under CC-BY-4.0.
